title: Gap spectra and densities of slow Fibonacci walks
summary: Let $F_1=F_2=1$ and $F_{t+2}=F_{t+1}+F_t$ for $t\geq1$. For every $n\geq2$, there are unique integers $a,b,t$ such that $n=aF_t+bF_{t-1}$ with $t\geq2$ and $1\leq a\leq b\leq F_t$. The Fibonacci walk with initial pair $(b,a)$ reaches $n$ as late as possible, and the term following $n$ in this walk is $\lfloorφn\rfloor$ when $t$ is even and $\lceilφn\rceil$ when $t$ is odd, where $φ=(1+\sqrt5)/2$. Let $D=\{d_1<d_2<\cdots\}$ and $U=\{u_1<u_2<\cdots\}$ be the sets corresponding to even and odd $t$, respectively. For $\ell,m\geq1$, define $D_\ell=\{d_{k+\ell}-d_k:k\geq1\}$,…
